title: Vinyasa Flow Yoga
description: A fluid sequence of poses that synchronises breath with movement to build strength and flexibility. Expect flowing transitions and a calm, focused finish.

title: Sunrise Hatha Yoga
description: A gentle, slower-paced class that holds classic poses to improve posture, balance and breathing. A welcoming start for anyone new to yoga.

title: Power Yoga Burn
description: A strong, athletic practice with long holds and challenging balances that builds heat and endurance. Best suited to those with regular yoga experience.

title: Restorative Evening Yoga
description: Supported poses and slow stretching to release tension at the end of the day. Props are provided, so you can relax fully and unwind.

title: Yoga for Core Strength
description: A lunchtime session that links yoga poses with core work to improve stability and posture. Short, focused and easy to fit into a busy day.

title: High Intensity HIIT
description: Explosive bursts and strength movements designed to burn calories and improve athletic fitness. Short rests keep your heart rate high throughout.

title: Tabata Express
description: Twenty seconds on, ten seconds off, repeated in blocks that fit a full workout into half an hour. Every move has an easier option.

title: Total Body Burn
description: Circuit stations that rotate through upper body, lower body and cardio to work every muscle group. A favourite after work, so it fills up fast.

title: Kettlebell Conditioning
description: Swings, cleans and carries that build power and grip strength with heavy kettlebells. Good lifting technique is expected.

title: Beginner HIIT Basics
description: Learn the key HIIT movements at a manageable pace, with plenty of coaching and rest between intervals. No experience needed.

title: Rhythm Spin Ride
description: A high-energy indoor cycling workout set to motivating music, with climbs, sprints and rolling hills. Our most popular early session.

title: Hill Climb Spin
description: Heavy resistance and long seated and standing climbs to build leg strength and stamina. Bring a towel and plenty of water.

title: Spin & Sculpt
description: Thirty-five minutes on the bike followed by a short upper body and core finisher with light weights.

title: Beginner Spin Intro
description: A relaxed introduction to indoor cycling with a bike setup guide, gentle intervals and clear cues from your instructor.

title: Sunset Endurance Ride
description: A steady, longer ride that builds aerobic fitness with sustained efforts and a mellow cool-down.

title: Mat Pilates Core
description: Focus on core strength, posture and flexibility through controlled movements and mindful breathing. Suitable for all fitness levels.

title: Reformer Fundamentals
description: Learn the reformer machine, with springs and straps that challenge your whole body. Small groups mean plenty of individual attention.

title: Pilates for Posture
description: Targeted exercises that strengthen the deep postural muscles of the back, shoulders and hips. A good fit if you spend long hours at a desk.

title: Advanced Pilates Flow
description: A demanding sequence of advanced mat and reformer work that tests control, balance and endurance. Previous Pilates experience is required.

title: Pilates & Stretch
description: Half strength, half stretch: controlled core work followed by a long, relaxing flexibility session to leave you feeling loose.

title: Power Boxing
description: Learn boxing technique while getting an excellent full-body conditioning workout. Pad work, bag rounds and fast footwork in every session.

title: Boxing Fundamentals
description: Stance, footwork and the basic punch combinations taught step by step. Gloves are available to borrow, so just turn up and learn.

title: Bag Work Blast
description: Timed rounds on the heavy bag mixed with core and cardio finishers to build punch power and stamina.

title: Fight Fit Conditioning
description: Fight-camp style training with sparring drills, ladder work and heavy conditioning. Intense, and open to experienced members only.

title: Cardio Boxing Social
description: A friendly, non-contact boxing cardio class you can enjoy with a friend. No fighting and no experience needed, just good energy.

title: Zumba Dance Party
description: A high-energy dance workout set to the hottest Latin and pop tracks. Easy to follow and great fun, whatever your dance skills.

title: Latin Rhythms Zumba
description: Salsa, merengue and reggaeton routines with faster choreography, for members who already enjoy dance fitness.

title: Zumba Gold
description: A lower-impact, easy-to-follow dance fitness class, ideal for older adults and anyone returning to exercise.

title: Zumba Toning
description: Dance fitness combined with light toning sticks to shape your arms, core and legs while you move to the beat.

title: Weekend Dance Fitness
description: A relaxed weekend party class with something for everyone, from first-timers to regular dancers. Bring a friend.
